snippet.title: AI 替你轉錯帳，美國大銀行說你自己賠｜完整版
snippet.description:
花旗、PNC、Citizens 這週把話講死：客戶讓第三方 AI 代理碰網銀帳戶，出了事客戶自己負責，連 AI 工具被駭、帳密外洩，駭客做的事也算客戶的。這集從摩根大通、美國銀行上個月的動作講起，看美國法律原本怎麼保護被盜轉的人、這次為什麼可能保護不到，富國銀行為什麼要你拿出「撤銷 AI」的證明，還有 AI 管錢接下來會走哪兩條路、台灣金管會在想什麼。

📌 這集的 5 個重點
1. 花旗、PNC、Citizens 這週改條款或寄信：外部 AI 代理出事，客戶負責。
2. 花旗多寫一句：AI 工具被駭、帳密外洩，駭客做的事也算客戶的；花旗自家的 AI 不加這條責任。
3. 美國 Regulation E 讓被盜轉的人最多賠 50 或 500 美元，但自己交出存取工具的轉帳不算「未經授權」，AI 出包可能整筆自負（第三方分析，還沒有法院測試過）。
4. 富國銀行新條款 11/24 生效，要客戶拿得出已撤銷 AI 代理的證明。
5. 想讓 AI 幫你看帳，用銀行核准的唯讀連線（例如 Anthropic 的理財功能走 Plaid、不碰密碼），網銀密碼不要交出去。

⏱ 章節
0:00 開場：鑰匙交給 AI，出事算你的
1:03 這週，三家銀行把話講死
2:24 上個月就開始：從擋門，到寫進合約
4:21 美國法律原本保護你，這次可能保護不到
6:05 富國銀行：說不用了，還要拿出證明
7:25 嘴上說資安，銀行還有另一筆帳
8:43 AI 管錢會分兩條路
10:56 結論：鑰匙給出去以前，先看清楚合約

📄 資料來源
・TechCrunch｜花旗、PNC、Citizens 改條款與花旗發言人說法：https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/18/more-banks-says-customers-using-ai-agents-are-on-their-own-even-if-they-get-hacked/
・富國銀行｜網路存取協議更新（11/24 生效）：https://www.wellsfargo.com/mobile-online-banking/updates/
・American Banker｜富國要客戶證明已撤銷 AI 代理：https://www.americanbanker.com/news/wells-fargo-wants-customers-to-prove-theyve-revoked-ai-agents
・CFPB｜Regulation E §1005.6 消費者責任上限：https://www.consumerfinance.gov/rules-policy/regulations/1005/6/
・CFPB｜Regulation E §1005.2(m) 未經授權轉帳的定義：https://www.consumerfinance.gov/rules-policy/regulations/1005/2/
・IBTimes UK｜摩根大通、摩根士丹利、嘉信、美銀的限制（轉述 Axios、FT）：https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-banks-restrict-third-party-ai-agents-1827325
・Cybernews｜摩根大通擋外部 AI 代理：https://cybernews.com/security/jpmorgan-chase-blocks-outside-ai-agents/
・Android Authority｜美國銀行的提醒信、花旗聲明：https://www.androidauthority.com/bank-of-america-ai-agent-password-warning-3728947/
・Startup Fortune｜Regulation E 的解讀（第三方分析）、現代卡測試：https://startupfortune.com/citi-pnc-and-citizens-tell-customers-they-own-any-loss-an-ai-agent-causes/
・Anthropic｜Claude 理財功能（唯讀）：https://claude.com/blog/introducing-personal-finance-in-claude
・中央社｜金管會代理 AI 安全諮詢文件：https://cna.com.tw/news/afe/202610130306.aspx
・CIOL｜ChatGPT Wallet：https://www.ciol.com/news/openai-launches-chatgpt-wallet-lets-ai-agents-make-purchases-12809961
花旗、摩根大通、美國銀行的說法來自媒體引述；Regulation E 的解讀是 Startup Fortune 的分析，不是法院或主管機關的意見。

如果銀行說 AI 出事你自己扛，你還會讓 AI 碰你的帳戶嗎？
資訊整理，非投資建議。

snippet.description:
Nvidia no vende inteligencia artificial: le vende las máquinas a todos los que sí la venden… y les cobra como si fuera un peaje. En un solo trimestre vendió 96.221 millones de dólares y se quedó con 75 de cada 100 como margen bruto. Hoy desarmamos el mecanismo completo con el documento en pantalla: el peaje, el candado (CUDA) y el bucle del dinero que sale de Nvidia… y vuelve a Nvidia comprando tarjetas. Y al final, las cuatro cosas para vigilar — incluida la salida de su fundador, Jensen Huang, confirmada esta misma semana.

snippet.title: Scammers Paid Off Her Debt With Stolen Money…Then It Vanished! Alexander Point Ep .11
snippet.description:
🚨 SCAMMERS “PAID OFF” HER CREDIT CARD—BUT THE MONEY WAS NEVER REALLY HERS! 🚨

In Alexander Point Episode 11, Ann—the fifth elderly victim rescued during the Alexander Point Saga—calls me back with information about even more scammers targeting her. What begins as a follow-up call quickly exposes just how deeply she has been pulled into multiple fraud operations. 🦊📞

Ann has three phones: one landline and two cell phones. All three are being used by different scammers trying to reach her. Once a person has been successfully victimized, their name and contact information may be sold, traded, or shared among criminal groups. That can lead to an endless stream of lottery scams, prize scams, bank impersonators, fake government agents, and fraudulent “claims representatives.”

Then Ann reveals something alarming: one scammer appeared to pay off her credit card, leaving her with a negative $679 balance. 💳💰

But the payment was not a gift. The scammer likely used fraudulent ACH information—possibly routing and account numbers stolen from another victim—to manufacture a temporary credit-card payoff. Once the unauthorized payment was rejected or reported, it was reversed and the debt returned.

A temporary zero or negative credit-card balance does NOT prove that a payment has fully cleared. Never spend restored credit, buy gift cards, send cryptocurrency, or purchase merchandise for someone claiming to have paid your debt. Call the card issuer directly using the number printed on the back of your card.

The warning signs keep piling up:

🔴 Multiple scam groups are calling Ann.  
📱 Scammers are reaching her through three separate phones.  
🏦 Several bank accounts were reportedly closed because of suspected fraud.  
💵 A scammer named David Myers allegedly deposited money into her accounts.  
☎️ A fake Bank of America verification line was later repurposed for Medicare fraud.  
📬 A United States Postal Inspector had already visited Ann.

These revelations raise a serious concern that Ann may have been unknowingly used as a long-term money mule—someone manipulated into receiving, depositing, or forwarding money stolen from other victims.

And this investigation is about to take a side quest. Ann gave me the name and phone number of another alleged scammer: Beverly Hilton. In the next episode, I call Beverly to discover what scam she is running. One scammer has now led me directly to another. 🦊🎯

Stop sending money and stop communicating with the suspected scammer. Contact your bank or credit-card company using a trusted number, preserve texts, emails, receipts and phone numbers, and report the fraud:

The culprit isn't a fuel shortage. It is Wall Street's $1 trillion artificial intelligence data center buildout.

Bank of America warns investors to brace for an "AI Air Pocket"—comparing today's debt-fueled server frenzy to the 19th-century railroad overbuild—while ordinary households and small businesses get stuck paying 20% to 40% higher monthly electric bills to subsidize new transmission lines.

In this ChillFinance investigation, we follow the money, the private credit loans, and the 7-year transformer bottleneck to uncover what happens when virtual code collides with the physical laws of the power grid.

snippet.title: I gestori tagliano il tech, come mai dal 2006: l'euforia AI è finita?
snippet.description:
I gestori del sondaggio di Bank of America hanno tagliato il sovrappeso sulla tecnologia dal 37% al 12%: -25 punti in un mese, il taglio più forte dal 2006.
Ecco perché la delusione sull'AI non è ancora paura: la liquidità resta al 3,6% e per Bank of America il segnale sulle azioni resta di vendita.

Perché il 52% dei gestori si aspetta che un hyperscaler annunci un taglio degli investimenti entro sei mesi, e perché Nvidia scende anche dopo aver battuto le attese.
I nuovi rischi di coda, cioè la bolla AI e un evento di credito degli hyperscaler, mentre il trade più affollato sui semiconduttori si svuota.
Soft landing e inflazione attesa in calo contro i verbali della Fed: cosa cambia per bond e oro.
La rotazione verso salute e consumi, le previsioni dei gestori per il 2027 e le quattro scommesse contro il consenso.
Dati: Global Fund Manager Survey di novembre di Bank of America, con 169 gestori che amministrano oltre 460 miliardi di dollari, intervistati dal 6 al 12 novembre, più i riscontri di JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs e Bloomberg.

snippet.title: 91% of Business Owners Say Costs Rose. Here's What to Do About It
snippet.description:
Nine out of ten business owners say their costs went up this year. If that's you, you're not alone, and today I want to talk about what to do about it.

I'm Michael Callahan, CPA, with Intentional Accounting. Yesterday, Bank of America released its 2026 Business Owner Report, a survey of small and mid-sized business owners. Here's what jumped out at me.

91% of owners say their costs increased over the last 12 months. Last year, that number was 77%. 75% are worried about inflation in the year ahead, and 79% raised their prices over the past year. Among those who did, the average increase was nearly 13%.

But here's the encouraging part. Owners aren't hunkering down. Nearly half, 49%, plan to expand. 58% expect revenue to grow over the next year, and 39% plan to hire. And 84% say they're using AI in some way, most often for marketing.

Why does this matter for you? Because when costs go up across the board, the businesses that come out ahead are the ones that know their numbers. If your costs rose and your prices didn't, your margin got squeezed, whether you noticed it or not. And this survey says most owners already adjusted.

Before the end of the year, pull your profit and loss for this year and last year side by side. Look at the top five expense lines and see how much each one grew. Then look at your margin on your main products or services. If it's shrinking, it may be time to review your pricing. And if you're planning to expand or hire in the next year, build a simple budget first, so you know what the growth really costs.

Jesus put it this way in Luke 14:28: "Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Won't you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to complete it?" Counting the cost isn't a lack of faith. It's good stewardship of what God has trusted you with.

snippet.description:
ESPECULACIÓN Y TRADING | Estrangulamiento de cortos en Wall Street, rebote en Bitcoin, oro y AMD

En esta edición de Pulso de Mercados, el analista Gabriel Montalto examina la situación técnica de Wall Street, el oro y las criptomonedas ante la elevada volatilidad provocada por la operativa de opciones con vencimiento diario (0DTE). Montalto destaca que la mesa de órdenes de Goldman Sachs ha advertido sobre el riesgo inminente de un estrangulamiento de posiciones cortas (short squeeze) en el S&P 500 de cara al importante vencimiento con strike en los 7.400 puntos, señalando que la recuperación de la media móvil de 200 sesiones consolidaría un soporte clave en los índices estadounidenses tras el fuerte volumen negociado en el Dow Jones en torno a los 49.050-50.500 puntos y en el Nasdaq 100 sobre los 26.600 puntos.

Respecto a las materias primas y los activos digitales, el experto subraya la estrecha correlación actual entre el oro —que sitúa en un soporte relevante en los 3.665 dólares tras una encuesta de Bank of America que lo califica en su mayor nivel de infravaloración desde 2008-2009— y Bitcoin. Montalto recuerda que la criptomoneda encadena su séptima semana consecutiva de caídas, un patrón estadístico que solo se ha repetido dos veces en los últimos 15 años y que históricamente ha precedido a rebotes técnicos, proyectando un posible impulso alcista de entre 8.000 y 10.000 dólares siempre que respete su soporte inmediato sin perder la zona de los 57.900-58.000 dólares. Finalmente, analiza la caída de AMD tras las acusaciones de Hunterbrook —manteniendo su soporte de referencia en los 389-390 dólares— y evalúa el escenario técnico de Nike ante un eventual rebote por sobreventa.
